g.text: Declare every zone, deploy them when you are ready
The zone list reserves each zone's replicas, whether or not the zone exists yet.
Activating one fills in replicas that were already accounted for, so nothing is redistributed.
Bootstrap with a zone held back
one replica of every partition per zone
2 of 3 replicas: a majority, the cluster runs
one replica of every partition per zone
No broker is renumbered. No partition is redistributed. The running zones are not restarted.
Leave at most one zone undeployed. With two or more missing, no partition holds a majority
